name: switchboard
description: Switchboard — macOS Stream Deck plugin: live keys for Claude Code, Codex CLI and Cursor CLI sessions, plus Safari tabs, app windows, window tiling, tmux panes and windows, BBEdit documents, files and snippets.

scripts.pack:zip: git diff --quiet HEAD -- com.movingavg.switchboard.sdPlugin || { echo 'pack:zip: the plugin folder has uncommitted changes; the zip ships committed files only' >&2; exit 1; }; mkdir -p dist && git archive --format=zip -o dist/com.movingavg.switchboard.sdPlugin.zip HEAD com.movingavg.switchboard.sdPlugin
